name: Dog
description: Loyal and active companion that thrives on attention and regular exercise.

name: Hamster
description: Small and low-maintenance pet, perfect for observation and gentle interaction.
info: The Hamster is a small, curious, and low-maintenance pet that is best suited for gentle handling and observation. Most hamsters are solitary animals and should be housed alone, as they may become aggressive toward other hamsters. They are generally healthy but may be prone to dental problems and obesity, so a balanced diet and a clean habitat are important. They also need an exercise wheel and enrichment to stay active.

name: Parrot
description: Intelligent and social bird that needs attention and mental stimulation.

name: Fish
description: Peaceful pets that are ideal for observation and relaxing environments.
info: Fish are peaceful, quiet pets that are ideal for people who enjoy observing rather than handling animals. Different species have different care requirements, but clean water, proper filtration, and a balanced diet are essential for their health. Regular aquarium maintenance helps prevent disease and provides a healthy environment for fish to thrive.

name: Rat
description: Intelligent and social pet that enjoys interacting with people.
info: The Rat is an intelligent, curious, and highly social pet that forms strong bonds with both people and other rats. They should not be kept alone, as companionship is important for their mental well-being. Rats are generally healthy but may be prone to respiratory infections and tumors, so regular veterinary check-ups and a clean environment are essential. Their short coat requires very little grooming, but they need daily enrichment and opportunities to explore.

name: Guinea Pig
description: Friendly and gentle pet that enjoys companionship.
info: The Guinea Pig is a gentle, social, and friendly pet that enjoys the company of other guinea pigs and human interaction. They should not be kept alone, as companionship is important for their well-being. This species is generally healthy but may be prone to dental problems and vitamin C deficiency, so a balanced diet and regular veterinary check-ups are essential. Their coat requires regular brushing, especially in long-haired breeds, and their enclosure should be kept clean.

name: Turtle
description: Calm and independent pet with simple daily care.
info: The Turtle is a calm, quiet, and low-maintenance pet that is well suited for people who prefer observation over interaction. Most pet turtles are generally healthy but require proper heating, UVB lighting, and a balanced diet to prevent shell and bone problems. Their habitat must be cleaned regularly, and with proper care, many species can live for several decades.
